screen.gatebound.awakening.title: Awakening
screen.gatebound.awakening.subtitle: Choose your path. This cannot be undone.
screen.gatebound.element.title: Elemental Affinity
screen.gatebound.element.subtitle: Choose your main element. Fate may grant you more.
element.gatebound.fire.desc: Burning bolts and blasts. Sets enemies alight.
element.gatebound.ice.desc: Frost shards and novas. Slows enemies down.
element.gatebound.lightning.desc: Fast, hard-hitting bolts and area storms.
element.gatebound.wind.desc: Gusts and cyclones. Throws enemies around.
element.gatebound.earth.desc: Stone spikes and armour. Tough and steady.
element.gatebound.light.desc: Radiant bolts and healing. Hurts foes, mends you.
screen.gatebound.spellpick.title: Choose a spell
screen.gatebound.spellpick.subtitle: Level %s: each of your elements offers a spell, but you can take only one
skill.gatebound.arc_bolt.desc: A fast bolt of lightning. Leaves Static; hitting Static chains the shock to the nearest enemy.
skill.gatebound.thunder_storm.desc: Lightning strikes every enemy within 7 blocks.
skill.gatebound.static_step.desc: Blink forward up to 9 blocks, shocking everything you pass.
skill.gatebound.overcharge.desc: For 30 s you are faster and every hit you land shocks the target.
skill.gatebound.chain_lightning.desc: A bolt that leaps through up to 8 enemies, weakening a little with each jump.
skill.gatebound.lightning_rod.desc: Plant a rod where you aim. For 12 s it calls bolts onto the enemies around it.
skill.gatebound.thunderstrike.desc: A huge bolt falls on the spot you aim at after a short warning.
skill.gatebound.storm_surge.desc: Surge forward up to 16 blocks as lightning, striking every enemy in your path.
skill.gatebound.thunder_god.desc: 20 s: you are very fast, bolts strike enemies around you, and your hits chain lightning. Lightning spells cost nothing.
skill.gatebound.gust.desc: A cone of wind that hurls enemies away from you.
skill.gatebound.cyclone.desc: Pulls enemies within 8 blocks in towards you and lifts them.
skill.gatebound.air_dash.desc: A fast dash in the direction you look, with a moment of invulnerability.
skill.gatebound.updraft.desc: Launches you and nearby allies into the air and slows the fall.
skill.gatebound.wind_blades.desc: Three fast slicing blades of wind.
skill.gatebound.wind_barrier.desc: For 8 s missiles that come near you are turned back on whoever fired them.
skill.gatebound.tornado.desc: A tornado where you aim that sweeps up and spins every enemy inside for 8 s.
skill.gatebound.tempest_flight.desc: Fly for 10 s: look where to go, jump to rise, sneak to sink. No fall damage.
skill.gatebound.wind_avatar.desc: 20 s: flight and speed, and every hit knocks enemies back. Wind spells cost nothing.
skill.gatebound.stone_spike.desc: A line of stone spikes erupts ahead of you, hurting and rooting enemies. Adds a Stone Armor stack.
skill.gatebound.stone_skin.desc: Resistance for 10 s and two Stone Armor stacks. Stacks give absorption and make earth spells hit 10% harder each.
skill.gatebound.stone_wall.desc: Raise a wall of stone in front of you. It crumbles after 10 s.
skill.gatebound.tremor.desc: The ground shakes: enemies within 7 blocks are hurt, stunned and weakened.
skill.gatebound.boulder.desc: Roll a boulder forward that crushes the first enemy it meets and hurts those around.
skill.gatebound.bedrock.desc: Maximum Stone Armor, strong resistance and a big absorption shield for 10 s.
skill.gatebound.earthquake.desc: For 6 s the ground around you erupts again and again, hurting and tossing enemies within 13 blocks.
skill.gatebound.landslide.desc: A wave of rock sweeps forward 22 blocks, flattening everything in its path.
skill.gatebound.titan_form.desc: 20 s: huge health, resistance and strength; your hits slam the ground. Earth spells cost nothing.
skill.gatebound.radiant_bolt.desc: A bolt of light that heals you a little. Undead take 50% more.
skill.gatebound.sanctuary.desc: A holy zone for 8 s that heals everyone inside and burns undead.
skill.gatebound.mending_light.desc: Heals you and every player within 9 blocks.
skill.gatebound.blinding_flash.desc: A flash that blinds enemies within 10 blocks and makes them lose track of you.
skill.gatebound.holy_smite.desc: A heavy blow of light on the enemy you look at. Undead take 50% more.
skill.gatebound.aegis.desc: Absorption and resistance for you and every player within 10 blocks.
skill.gatebound.judgement.desc: A pillar of light falls on the spot you aim at after a short warning, scorching everything in it.
skill.gatebound.resurrection.desc: Blesses you and nearby players for 60 s: the next killing blow instead leaves you at half health.
skill.gatebound.seraph_form.desc: 20 s: flight, regeneration, an aura that heals allies and burns enemies. Light spells cost nothing.
skill.gatebound.shadow_bolt.desc: A bolt of darkness that lays Curse. Cursed enemies take 20% more from you and feed you when they die.
skill.gatebound.void_grasp.desc: Tendrils drag enemies within 9 blocks towards you and root them. Curses them.
skill.gatebound.hex.desc: Curse the enemy you look at: it deals far less damage and is cursed for 30 s.
skill.gatebound.life_siphon.desc: Drain the enemy you look at for 3 s, healing yourself. Keep looking at it.
skill.gatebound.dread.desc: Enemies within 11 blocks are cursed and flee in terror for 4 s.
skill.gatebound.soul_harvest.desc: Reaps every enemy you have cursed within 18 blocks for big damage. Needs cursed enemies.
skill.gatebound.black_hole.desc: Costs 4 health. Drags everything into a point for 6 s, then collapses for huge damage.
skill.gatebound.eclipse.desc: Costs 4 health. Blinds and curses enemies within 24 blocks; for 12 s you are fast and heal from what you hit.
skill.gatebound.void_lord.desc: Costs 6 health. 20 s: curses spread with every hit, void pulses drain enemies around you. Dark spells cost nothing.
element.gatebound.dark.desc: Curses and drain. Cursed foes feed you when they die.
skill.gatebound.fireball.desc: Hurl a fireball that explodes and sets enemies alight. Burning enemies take 25% more fire damage.
skill.gatebound.flame_burst.desc: A burst of flame around you that scorches nearby enemies.
skill.gatebound.ignite.desc: For 30 s your weapon and arrows set targets alight, and you resist fire.
skill.gatebound.flame_wall.desc: A wall of fire where you aim. Burns everything that stands in it for 8 s.
skill.gatebound.immolate.desc: A burning aura around you for 12 s that scorches nearby enemies. You resist fire.
skill.gatebound.combustion.desc: Detonates every burning enemy within 20 blocks for heavy damage. Needs burning enemies.
skill.gatebound.meteor.desc: Call a meteor onto the spot you aim at. It lands after 1.5 s.
skill.gatebound.inferno.desc: A vast field of fire at the spot you aim at for 10 s.
skill.gatebound.ifrit_form.desc: 20 s: a fire aura burns enemies, your hits blast their neighbours, fire spells cost nothing.
skill.gatebound.frost_shard.desc: A fast shard of ice. Adds Chill; at 3 Chill the target freezes solid.
skill.gatebound.frost_nova.desc: A ring of frost around you. Adds 2 Chill to nearby enemies.
skill.gatebound.ice_armor.desc: For 30 s you take less damage and attackers are chilled.
skill.gatebound.glacial_path.desc: Freeze a bridge ahead of you over water, lava and gaps. It melts after 8 s.
skill.gatebound.icicle_barrage.desc: Loose a fan of seven icicles, each adding Chill.
skill.gatebound.shatter.desc: Breaks every frozen enemy within 18 blocks for big damage. Needs frozen enemies.
skill.gatebound.blizzard.desc: A storm at the spot you aim at for 10 s that chills everything inside.
skill.gatebound.absolute_zero.desc: Freezes every enemy within 20 blocks solid.
skill.gatebound.frost_sovereign.desc: 20 s: everything you hit freezes, enemies near you are chilled, ice spells cost nothing.
screen.gatebound.status.title: Status
screen.gatebound.status.hint: Press the status key again to close
stat.gatebound.agility.desc: +0.4% move speed and +0.02 attack speed per point
stat.gatebound.intellect.desc: +4 max mana, faster mana regen and stronger spells
class.gatebound.warrior.desc: Front-line fighter. Hits hard and takes hits.
class.gatebound.rogue.desc: Fast and lucky. Strikes quickly and slips away.
class.gatebound.mage.desc: Elemental caster. Pick an affinity, and you may awaken to more.
class.gatebound.ranger.desc: Mobile marksman. Balanced speed, power and fortune.
class.gatebound.summoner.desc: Commands allies from the other side.
gatebound.echo.fallen: Your echo (%s) has fallen. Summon it again when ready.
gatebound.echo.none: You have no echoes yet. Defeat monsters as a Summoner to bind them.
gatebound.echo.all_out: All your echoes are already out.
gatebound.npc.hint: Prices scale with your level. Stock restocks daily.
gatebound.tower.enter: You pass beneath the arch of the Spire.
gatebound.tower.forming: The floor takes shape around you...
gatebound.tower.rest: A safe haven. Rest by the fire; you will wake here if you fall.
gatebound.tower.boss: A guardian lairs on this floor. The way up is sealed until it falls.
skill.gatebound.rally.desc: All your echoes return to your side, drop their fights and run faster for 5 s.
skill.gatebound.command_strike.desc: Mark the enemy you look at: all echoes in range attack it for 6 s with +50% damage.
skill.gatebound.empower.desc: Echoes in range deal more damage (grows with Intellect) and take less for 20 s.
skill.gatebound.soul_link.desc: Echoes in range heal themselves (and a little of you) from the damage they deal, for 15 s.
skill.gatebound.sacrifice.desc: Consume the echo you look at for health and mana. It returns when you summon again.
skill.gatebound.soul_swap.desc: Swap places with the echo you look at.
skill.gatebound.bind_chains.desc: Root the enemy you look at and those around it with spectral chains. Lasts longer with level.
skill.gatebound.legion_call.desc: Spectral copies of all your echoes fight beside you for a while. They use no slots.
skill.gatebound.soul_storm.desc: Every echo unleashes a heavy burst on its nearest enemy.
skill.gatebound.ascension.desc: Echoes in range gain huge damage, regeneration and a shield for 30 s.
skill.gatebound.sovereigns_domain.desc: Your echoes are untouchable and strike with triple force for 15 s; nearby enemies are slowed and weakened.
skill.gatebound.shadow_step.desc: Dash forward in a blur, untouchable for a moment.
skill.gatebound.throwing_knives.desc: Hurl knives at up to three enemies in a line. Each is briefly marked.
skill.gatebound.vanish.desc: Slip into Shadow: invisible, enemies lose you, and you run faster. Your next strike is an Ambush.
skill.gatebound.mark_for_death.desc: Mark an enemy for 15 s. It takes 25% more damage from you, and an Ambush on it always crits and refunds mana.
skill.gatebound.shadow_meld.desc: Hide in the shadow of the creature you look at (or your own). Enemies ignore you; sneak or attack to leave. Hold W to hop between shadows.
skill.gatebound.venom_blade.desc: For 20 s your hits poison, and wither marked enemies.
skill.gatebound.backstab.desc: Teleport behind the enemy you look at and strike it from behind.
skill.gatebound.smoke_bomb.desc: Blind and slow enemies around you, make them lose you, and melt into Shadow for 3 s.
skill.gatebound.fan_of_knives.desc: Throw knives in every direction, hurting and marking everything near you.
skill.gatebound.blade_dance.desc: Teleport through nearby enemies in five rapid strikes, marked ones first, then return.
skill.gatebound.execute.desc: Strike harder the more wounded an enemy is. Kills non-bosses below 25% health, refunding mana.
skill.gatebound.shadow_dance.desc: For 10 s Shadow never breaks and every hit is an Ambush. Meld and Shadow Walk cost nothing.
skill.gatebound.thousand_cuts.desc: Mark every enemy within 16 blocks, then slash each in a blinding sequence.
skill.gatebound.shadow_possession.desc: Your shadow rises: up to five enemies in front are bound, pulled, struck by shadow arms and finally possessed. Cast again to pull, sneak-cast to leap, hold sneak to end.
skill.gatebound.shockwave.desc: Slam the ground, damaging and hurling back every enemy around you.
skill.gatebound.war_cry.desc: Roar: Strength and Resistance for 10 s or more, and every enemy within 12 blocks turns on you.
skill.gatebound.charge.desc: Rush forward, untouchable at first, bowling over and stunning every enemy you touch.
skill.gatebound.cleave.desc: A wide sweep that hits every enemy in front of you.
skill.gatebound.iron_skin.desc: Resistance II and Absorption for a long while.
skill.gatebound.leap_slam.desc: Leap forward and crash down, damaging and launching enemies where you land.
skill.gatebound.rending_strike.desc: A heavy blow on the enemy in front that leaves it bleeding for 5 s.
skill.gatebound.bulwark.desc: Resistance III, and 30% of the melee damage you take is struck back at the attacker.
skill.gatebound.whirlwind.desc: Spin, hitting everything around you four times.
skill.gatebound.second_wind.desc: Heal a third of your health, shake off every harmful effect and gain a burst of speed.
skill.gatebound.crushing_blow.desc: A devastating single hit that stuns, and hits half again as hard against enemies below half health.
skill.gatebound.berserker_rage.desc: Strength II and Speed, and you heal for 15% of the damage you deal.
skill.gatebound.earthbreaker.desc: Spring into the air and break the earth on landing: three shockwaves ripple out, launching and stunning all.
skill.gatebound.avatar_of_war.desc: For 20 s or more you are war itself: huge Strength, Resistance and Regeneration, a pulse of damage every second, 25% lifesteal, and a final slam when it ends.
skill.gatebound.eagle_eye.desc: Your sight sharpens: every enemy within 24 blocks glows.
skill.gatebound.piercing_shot.desc: Your next shot becomes an instant ray through up to three enemies in a line. Needs a bow.
skill.gatebound.homing_shot.desc: Aim at a mob, a player, a wooden button, a target block or a bell to lock on (up to 96 blocks, not through walls). Your next arrow curves to it from any distance. Needs a bow.
skill.gatebound.hunters_quarry.desc: Mark the enemy you look at. Your arrows hit it 30% harder, seeking arrows chase it, and its death refunds mana.
skill.gatebound.evasive_roll.desc: Spring backward out of danger, untouchable for a moment, and snap off an arrow at the nearest enemy.
skill.gatebound.poison_arrow.desc: Imbues your next arrow with poison. Needs a bow.
skill.gatebound.snare_arrow.desc: Imbues your next arrow to pin its target in place for 3 seconds. Needs a bow.
skill.gatebound.multishot.desc: Your next shot splits into a fan of five arrows. Needs a bow.
skill.gatebound.ricochet.desc: Your next shot becomes an instant ray that bounces between up to four enemies. Needs a bow.
skill.gatebound.rain_of_arrows.desc: Imbues your next arrow: where it lands, arrows rain in from all around. Needs a bow.
skill.gatebound.headshot.desc: Your next shot becomes a devastating instant ray. Double on your quarry, and it finishes any non-boss below 20% health. Needs a bow.
skill.gatebound.hunters_trance.desc: For 12 s or more your skills cost no mana, you move faster, and every arrow you loose seeks its prey.
skill.gatebound.arrow_barrage.desc: Your next shot unleashes twenty seeking arrows over every enemy within 30 blocks. Needs a bow.
skill.gatebound.apex_predator.desc: For 20 s or more every enemy within 32 blocks is your quarry. A spectral arrow strikes each of them every second, your arrows seek, and kills add time.
